capabilities: Edit table cells directly in Live Preview with Markdown, embeds, and math
Merge, split, reorder, and sort rows and columns
Render bar, pie, and line charts from table data
Convert tables between Vtable, Markdown, and HTML
disambiguation: Not related to ByteDance's VTable (VisActor) charting library; the name is a prefix from the author's own plugin series.
extras: README includes a disclaimer that it has no affiliation with ByteDance's VTable (VisActor); bilingual Chinese/English UI; installable via BRAT; an external AI skill documenting the table syntax is available.
problem: Native Markdown tables cannot merge cells, render rich content inside cells, compute formulas, or style rows and columns, which limits table-based note-taking.
summary: Enhanced editable tables in ```vtable code blocks with cell merging, in-cell Markdown, Excel-style formulas, SVG charts, and Markdown/HTML conversion.
